name: bambu-dashboard
description: Self-hosted LAN dashboard for Bambu Lab 3D printers

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
